passage.label: Seen one turned away; gave little refrained; knowledge unseen sees; not informed scriptures Moses; Abraham fulfilled obligations; bearer burdens bear burden another; not man except strives; effort going seen; recompensed fullest recompense; Lord finality; makes laugh weep; causes death gives life; creates two mates male female; sperm-drop emitted; incumbent upon Him next creation; enriches suffices; Lord Sirius; destroyed first Aad; Thamud not spare; people Noah before more unjust oppressing; overturned towns hurled down; covered by that covered; which favors Lord doubt

arabicExcerpts.text: أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
وَقَوۡمَ نُوحٖ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ

mainSubject.label: The one who turned away and gave little then refrained challenged on unseen knowledge; reminded of what was in the scriptures of Moses and Abraham who fulfilled his obligations — that no bearer bears another's burden, man has only what he strives for, his effort will be seen and fully recompensed, the finality belongs to the Lord who makes laugh and weep, causes death and gives life, creates male and female pairs from emitted sperm-drop, owes the next creation, enriches and suffices, and is Lord of Sirius; the destruction of the first Aad, Thamud without sparing, and Noah's people as even more unjust recalled; the overturned towns hurled down and covered; all posed as favors none should doubt

subordinateSubjects.label: Have you seen the one who turned away
And gave a little then refrained
Does he have knowledge of the unseen so he sees
Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
And Abraham who fulfilled his obligations
That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
And that there is not for man except that for which he strives
And that his effort is going to be seen
Then he will be recompensed with the fullest recompense
And that to your Lord is the finality
And that it is He who makes one laugh and weep
And that it is He who causes death and gives life
And that He creates the two mates, male and female
From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
And that incumbent upon Him is the next creation
And that it is He who enriches and suffices
And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
And that He destroyed the first Aad
And Thamud, and He did not spare them
And the people of Noah before, indeed they were more unjust and oppressing
And the overturned towns He hurled down
And covered them by that which He covered
Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt

notes: Wave 8 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the greatest-signs affirmation (18) before the idol-challenge block opens (19); P2 ends with the self-purification prohibition (32) before the Musa-Ibrahim scripture reminders begin (33); P3 runs through the ethical axioms, divine attributes and destruction catalogue closing with the favors question (33-55); P4 covers the warner-identity, Approaching Day, their misplaced wonder and the closing prostration command (56-62).
